{{Meta Support Unit}}
==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythical}} unit. This unit is a part of [[Griffin (Ascension)]], it is activated by sacrificing buff units.

He buffs all units' damage by 100%, including other users' units. His buff stacks with other buff units such as [[Commander|{{RarityColor|Legendary|Commander}}]], [[Wind Dragon|{{RarityColor|Legendary|Wind Dragon}}]], [[Elfy (Sylph)|{{RarityColor|Mythic|Elfy (Sylph)}}]], [[Blossom|{{RarityColor|Rare|Blossom}}]], [[Skeleton (Soul King)|{{RarityColor|Mythic|Skeleton (Soul King)}}]]. [[Idol (Star)|{{RarityColor|Mythic|Idol (Star)}}]]

==Trivia==

* This buff scales additionally with [[Blossom]] and [[Idol (Star)]], this means that the multiplier for your towers will be 2.1x for [[Blossom]] and 2.15x for [[Idol (Star)]].
